Snapshot recovery prototypes for block hashes, manifest, banks, and vote state credits.

# Purpose
This header file declares recovery functions used during snapshot restore and blockhash reconstruction. The [`blockhashes_recover`](<#blockhashes_recover>) function rebuilds blockhash state from snapshot manifest blockhash data, a count of entries, and a seed value. The [`fd_ssload_recover`](<#fd_ssload_recover>) function restores snapshot-related state into the manifest, banks, bank, and vote state credit structures. The file contains only function prototypes and include guards, so it serves as an interface for restore utilities.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `blockhashes_recover`
- `fd_ssload_recover`
